_rationale: MONOTONIC graphical-fidelity floor for the asset QC gate (gates/design/asset-qc-gate.mjs). Every field is a MINIMUM a baked asset GLB must meet BEFORE it is imported into a world; the floor only ever RATCHETS UP (via ratchetFloor/raiseFloor), never down, climbing toward the Project Gorgon ceiling. Seed values were measured from a real, good, textured kit building (assets/kit-building.glb) then set with headroom below it so that building passes while a degenerate box (single flat-colour material, ~a dozen tris, no albedo map, speck bbox) hard-fails.

building._note: Buildings are the biggest fidelity gap vs the ceiling. Floor sits below the measured reference (verts 4686, tris 894, mats 3, bbox 9x6.15x7.3) with margin so the reference passes; a flat-box cottage fails on verts+tris+materials+albedo+bbox at once.

ratchetTargets: requiresNormalMap: true — the #1 raise. The current reference bakes NO normal map, so requiring one now would reject the very asset the floor is seeded from. raiseFloor() flips this true the moment a normal-mapped building passes; the gate already enforces it when true.
minTriangleCount / minVertexCount climb toward PG as denser kits land.
class-specific colour palette conformance strengthens once baked textures can be sampled (see gate's documented approximation).
